note: vp is required — a submission with no presentation gives the witness nothing to verify.
Unknown top-level member is rejected; ecosystem data belongs under `ext` (SPEC.md §4.5.1). Attestation evidence rides inside the presentation or under a namespaced ext, never as an ad-hoc member.
memberPresentation is a presentation object, never a bare DID or a string — a witness given a member DID with nothing signed by it has no evidence the submitter holds the member key.

memberPresentation does not replace vp — the relationship presentation is still required, and a submission carrying only the member presentation gives the witness no relationship credential to attest.
